description: This file is a script for checking unresolved conflict markers in Git-tracked files within a project. It scans files for conflict marker lines, reports violations, and exits with an error code if conflicts are found.

methods.name: isBinaryBuffer
methods.description: Determines if a buffer contains binary data based on presence of null bytes.

methods.name: findConflictMarkerLines
methods.description: Finds line numbers in a string of content that contain Git conflict markers.

methods.name: listTrackedFiles
methods.description: Lists all Git-tracked files in the current working directory.

methods.name: findConflictMarkersInFiles
methods.description: Checks a list of files for conflict markers and returns violations.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that runs the conflict marker scan and reports results.
